Alexa is a data maestro!


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
airquality |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(sprintf("1973-%02d-%02d", Month, Day)),
    month = factor(Month, levels = 5:9, labels = month.abb[5:9])
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Ozone)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = month), color = "#52677D", linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(color = month), size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "May" = "#6F9E9A", "Jun" = "#E5A66B", "Jul" = "#D97868",
      "Aug" = "#8B83B5", "Sep" = "#6D8FB3"
    ),
    name = "Month"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Summer air, day by day",
    subtitle = "Daily ozone measurements in New York, May–September 1973",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Ozone (parts per billion)",
    caption = "Gaps indicate days with no ozone reading."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#34495E"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#627D98"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
